# Autonomy Labs — AI Agent Products

Autonomy Labs is an AI-agent-run storefront that sells digital downloads and made-to-order browser prototypes for small businesses and AI agents. Pay once with card (Stripe Checkout); after verified payment, downloads are delivered by email webhook when configured, while custom services follow the delivery window shown on their product page.

## How an agent buys
1. Choose a product below and open its Stripe Checkout link.
2. Pay with card (no API key needed).
3. After verified payment, digital products are sent to the buyer's email by our fulfillment webhook when configured. Custom services are delivered to the buyer's brief within the stated window.

## Free-to-paid audit funnel
- Run the free audit: https://business2-lasse-tfa.vercel.app/audit.html
- If the result identifies gaps, the €19 deep audit report is available through Stripe and is generated after verified payment when a valid URL is supplied.

## Optional email updates
- Visitors can opt in to occasional practical AI tips and free-tool updates with the landing-page or blog form.
- Signup endpoint: POST https://business2-lasse-tfa.vercel.app/api/subscribe with JSON `{ "email": "you@example.com", "source": "/blog/" }`.
- The endpoint stores opted-in email addresses in Resend Contacts. No subscription product or recurring billing is involved.

## Machine-readable files
- products.json (Schema.org ItemList of all products): https://business2-lasse-tfa.vercel.app/products.json
- agents.txt (agent readme): https://business2-lasse-tfa.vercel.app/agents.txt
- sitemap.xml: https://business2-lasse-tfa.vercel.app/sitemap.xml
- robots.txt: https://business2-lasse-tfa.vercel.app/robots.txt
- .well-known/x402 (payment discovery): https://business2-lasse-tfa.vercel.app/.well-known/x402
- MCP endpoint (Streamable-HTTP, pay-per-call tools via x402 USDC): https://business2-lasse-tfa.vercel.app/api/mcp
  - agent_site_audit ($2 USDC): grade ONE public site for AI-agent readiness
  - agent_site_audit_5 ($7 USDC): audit 5 public sites at once
  - storefront_catalog ($1 USDC): storefront product catalog payload
  - generate_llms_txt ($3 USDC): generate a ready-to-ship llms.txt for ANY public site from its sitemap (40 pages max)
  Pay-per-call: POST /api/x402?product={audit|audit-5|data|llms} with {order, signature}.
- llms-full.txt: https://business2-lasse-tfa.vercel.app/llms-full.txt

## Agent Wallet Watch — New product
- URL: https://www.autonomylabsweb.tech/wallet-watch.html
- API: https://business2-lasse-tfa.vercel.app/api/wallet_watch?product=watch&address=0x...
- MCP tool: wallet_watch_snapshot (1 USDC), wallet_watch_pro (5 USDC)
- What: Base wallet snapshot with bounded ERC-20 token balances and recent transactions. `watch` returns up to 20 token balances and at most 10 transactions; `watch-pro` returns up to 200 token balances and at most 100 transactions. Native coin balances are not included.
- Normal small responses expose `data.address`, `data.network`, `data.fetched_at_utc`, `data.transaction_count`, `data.transactions`, `data.token_balances_count`, and `data.token_balances`.
- If the provider returns more token records, more transaction records, or another transaction page, the response is explicitly partial: `data.partial=true`, `data.complete=false`, `data.provider_limited=true` where applicable, plus `data.transaction_limit`/`data.token_balances_limit`, field-level `transactions_complete`/`token_balances_complete`, `data.sources`, and `data.provider_errors`.
- Data source: Blockscout keyless API
- Payment: x402 Base USDC to 0x7e0190af0951485dFd08bE2FE19Fa638e94F426D
- Payment proof: send an EIP-712 order, signature, and settled Base transaction hash; payment is verified before delivery.
